'''4A-2R''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and member of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
4A-2R had the body of a [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] and an oversized head containing surveillance equipment.

==History==
The droid was first seen on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> when he and [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's pirate gang]] were scavenging a crashed [[Count Dooku's solar sailer/Legends|solar sailer]]. The gang met [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and offered him a passage to the nearest planet, [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], six [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] away. The droid was later on the planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] at a bar in [[Hondo's complex/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's pirate outpost]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Three droids of the same type are shown simultaneously in the episode "[[Lethal Trackdown]]," and it is unknown which one is 4A-2R.
